outbreak_frequency: Cites prior Harare typhoid outbreaks: Davis 2018 (Oct 2016-Mar 2017), CDC 2012 report (Oct 2011-May 2012), Polonsky 2014 (2012 epidemic), Muti 2014 (Dzivaresekwa, 2011); recurrent/near-annual
endemicity: Not stated explicitly as 'endemic'; described as recurrent, water-shortage-driven outbreaks
seasonality: Poor water/sanitation + overcrowding is 'persistent driver of seasonal outbreaks of waterborne diseases in Harare'
notes: TCV outbreak-response campaign (Gavi-funded), Jan-Feb 2019, 350,000 targeted, first TCV use/first outbreak response vax in Africa; prior outbreaks tied to municipal water shortages, contaminated boreholes/wells
